SELECT order_row.order_no, customer_row.customer_no, customer_row.name AS customer_name, order_row.amount, order_row.status, COUNT(item_row.id) AS item_count, COALESCE(SUM(item_row.quantity), 0) AS total_quantity, order_row.created_at FROM purchase_orders order_row JOIN customers customer_row ON customer_row.id = order_row.customer_id LEFT JOIN order_items item_row ON item_row.order_id = order_row.id
GROUP BY order_row.id, order_row.order_no, customer_row.customer_no, customer_row.name, order_row.amount, order_row.status, order_row.created_at ORDER BY order_row.created_at DESC, order_row.order_no DESC LIMIT #{size} OFFSET #{offset}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM purchase_orders order_row JOIN customers customer_row ON customer_row.id = order_row.customer_id
